title: The Neighbour
setting: 9pm. You're unpacking a kettle. A small steady knock at the door — not the urgent kind. When you open it, there's a woman in a salwar, holding a small steel container, smiling like she's been thinking about this for an hour.

beats.beat: holds out the steel container — something is warm inside

choices.en: Hello, madam! Thank you. What's this?
Oh, thank you so much. You really didn't have to.

beats.native: Bisi bele bath. ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ extra ಮಾಡಿದ್ದೆ. ಹೊಸ ಮನೆ ಮೊದಲ ರಾತ್ರಿ ಊಟ ಮಾಡಿಲ್ಲ ತಾನೇ?
beats.translit: bisi bele bath. svalpa extra māḍidde. hosa mane modala rātri ūṭa māḍilla tānē?
beats.en: Bisi bele bath. I made a bit extra. First night in a new place — you haven't eaten, right?
beats.beat: she did know. she made extra on purpose.

beats.native: ನೀವು ಯಾವ ಊರಿನವರು ಸಾರ್? Accent ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಬೇರೆ ಇದೆ.
beats.translit: nīvu yāva ūrinavaru sār? accent svalpa bēre ide.
beats.en: Where are you from, boss? Your accent is a little different.
beats.beat: not pushy — Indiranagar's too small not to ask

choices.native: Engineering job ಗೆ Bangalore ಗೆ ಬಂದಿದ್ದೇನೆ ಮ್ಯಾಡಮ್. ಹೊಸಬ.
choices.translit: engineering job-ge Bangalore-ge bandiddēne madam. hosaba.
choices.en: Came to Bangalore for an engineering job, madam. I'm new.
I just moved here for work.

beats.native: ಆಯ್ತು. ಯಾವುದೇ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆ ಇದ್ದರೆ, knock ಮಾಡಿ ಸಾರ್. ನಾನು ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆ ಎಂಟರ ಹೊತ್ತಿಗೆ office ಗೆ ಹೋಗ್ತೀನಿ — ಮೊದಲು ಸಿಗ್ತೀನಿ.
beats.translit: āytu. yāvudē samasye iddare, knock māḍi sār. nānu beḷigge eṇṭara hottige office-ge hōgtīni — modalu sigtīni.
beats.en: Okay. Any trouble, just knock, boss. I leave for the office around eight — you'll find me before then.
beats.beat: already turning to go. neighbourly without being nosy.

choices.native: ಧನ್ಯವಾದಗಳು ಮ್ಯಾಡಮ್. ಕಿಚನ್ ಸೆಟ್ ಆದ ಮೇಲೆ ನೀವು ಊಟಕ್ಕೆ ಬರಬೇಕು.
choices.translit: dhanyavādagaḷu madam. kitchen set āda mēle nīvu ūṭakke barabēku.
choices.en: Thank you, madam. Once the kitchen is set up, you must come over for a meal.
